questions.prompt: Tafewwit s ukrurej d yiri azeggaɣ temmal s umata :
questions.explanation: Akrurej s yiri azeggaɣ d tafewwit n umihi. Temmal-d amihi ticki teqreb-d.
Izirig yezdi ur ilaq ara ad yettwakreẓ neɣ ad yettwaseqdec i uɛeddi.

questions.prompt: Ticki tili tafat tazeggaɣt, asenked ilaq :

options.label: Ad isenɣes tazzla sakin ad iɛeddi ma yella abrid d ilelli
Ad iḥbes uqbel n yizirig n uḥbas neɣ n tfat
Ad iɛerḍ s uɣellab iwakken ad d-yelɣu

questions.explanation: Tafat tazeggaɣt tessuter aḥbas ummid uqbel ad tɛeddiḍ ticki tewweḍ tazegzawt.

questions.prompt: Deg unmeɣri war asɣel, alugen amezwaru d :
questions.explanation: Ma ulac tafewwit neɣ tafat, eǧǧ abrid i win d-yusan s yeffus-ik.

options.label: Tikeṛṛusin yellan deg tuzzya ɣur-sent tazwart

questions.explanation: Imawsanen yellan yakan deg tuzzya ɣur-sen tazwart, arma yella usɣel nniḍen.

options.label: Ɣef tarrayt s sin n yiɣallen

questions.explanation: Izirig yezdi yeqqaz ad tɛeddiḍ ɣef tlemmast iwakken ad tɛeddiḍ takeṛṛust.

options.label: Ad tjerred ma tḥebbes takeṛṛust yellan zdat-ik

questions.explanation: Yettɛiṭṭel akud d umkan iwakken ad tḥebseḍ war amtawa.

questions.prompt: Ticki tmuɣli d tameẓẓyant (ageffur, tagut), ilaq :

options.label: Ad tremdeḍ tifawin sakin ad tesɛeddiḍ tazzla
Ad tsenseḍ tifawin iwakken ur d-tessewḍeḍ ara

questions.explanation: Ad k-walin sakin ad tsenɣeseḍ tazzla yesseɣla tɣellist ticki tarrayt ur tettban ara akken ilaq.

options.label: Asnerni n tazzla s tezmert deg yal tuffɣa
Ad teǧǧeḍ amsedday ad yeddu deg umkan ilelli ɣef waṭas n wakud

questions.explanation: Azwir isenqes iḥebsiyen iserrḥanen yerna isenqes asɣiwes.

questions.prompt: Ɣef tarrayt tameqqrant, iwakken ad tkecmeḍ ɣer ubrid arurad :

options.label: Kcem s usɛeddi n tazzla-k ɣer usikel
Ḥbes ɣef tebdut n usnerni n tazzla

questions.explanation: Tebdut n usnerni n tazzla tettwaseqdec iwakken ad tkecmeḍ s twala d usɛeddi n tazzla.

questions.prompt: Zdat n umḍakul ɣef ubrid yettwaḥerzen :

options.label: Snerni tazzla iwakken ad tɛeddiḍ zdat-es
Eǧǧ abrid sakin ḥbes ma yella d ayen ilaqen
Ɛreḍ s uɣellab iwakken ad t-id-telɣuḍ

questions.explanation: Imḍakalen yekcemen ɣef ubrid yettwaḥerzen ɣur-sen tazwart.

questions.prompt: Ma yella amihi, tikli ilaq ad tebdu s :
questions.explanation: PAS : ḥrez tamnaḍt, lɣu i tallelt, sakin ɛiwen war ma tessekcameḍ iman-ik ɣer umihi.
